notes.title: Jackbox Games at C2E2
notes.notes:
Are you going to C2E2 this year? We sure are! Join us at McCormick Place from [b]April 26-28th[/b] for some incredible panels with special guests, chat with Jackbox game devs, and play games for a chance to win prizes.

Play games with us! 

Come join Jackbox game devs to play some Jackbox fan-favorites and a few hidden gems. We’ll be in The Yard (Revolution Brewing) handing out prizes to winners. 

[h3]Here’s when you can find us in the Yard:[/h3][list]
[*] Friday 4/26 from 12:30-3:30pm
[*] Saturday 4/27 from 11am-2pm
[*] Sunday 4/28 from 1:30-4:30pm
[/list]
[b][h2]Catch our three incredible panels![/h2][/b]
[h3][b]1. Chicago Comedy Panel:[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Friday 4/26 from 7-8pm 
[*] Location: S401-D[/list]
[url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/blog/play-games-attend-panels][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2486624840455330680/F85364F76F8263E3CE85DBEEFBD2948B05157593/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img][/url] 

Join some of the funniest writers in the city from Jackbox Games, The Onion, Clickhole, and more as they play through fan-favorite party games with YOU, the audience! Special guests include Hannah Wolansky, Mike Gillis, Nick Mehendale, Steve Etheridge, Chad Nackers, and Liz Anderson.

[h3][b]2. The Jackbox Games Showdown with the Chicago Freelance Wrestling Association:[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Saturday 4/27 from 4:45-5:45pm 
[*] Location: S401-ABC[/list]
[url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/blog/play-games-attend-panels][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2486624840455374170/45AA6B861D733C3BDAB342671C050F7DA3C365F3/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img][/url]

Come celebrate Chicago’s illustrious comedy and wrestling scene as members of the Freelance Wrestling roster challenge each other to an epic party game battle. Members of the audience will be able to play along and help decide the outcome of each match! Special guests include "The King of Clubs" Jason Midas, "The Generational Treasure" Shaq Jordan, "The Very Good Boy" Stone Ambrose, "The Big Picture" Nick Kotas, and "The Founder of the Team Alfonso Dojo" Alfonso Gonzalez.

[h3][b]3. Gag! x Jackbox Game Night[/b][/h3][list]
[*] Saturday 4/27 from 6:30-7:30pm
[*] Location: S401-D[/list]
[url=https://www.jackboxgames.com/blog/play-games-attend-panels][img]https://steamuserimages-a.akamaihd.net/ugc/2486624840455368109/689199832BE844D94911E350D6E560AABEA75F12/?imw=5000&imh=5000&ima=fit&impolicy=Letterbox&imcolor=%23000000&letterbox=false[/img][/url]

Join our “after hours” party game night with some of the most beloved drag artists in Chicago, including members of Gag! Hosted by Jackbox Games and featuring hilarious party games that audience members will be able to join in on. Special guests include Derry Queen, Malheurt, Secret Queen, Rachel Slurrz, Ari Gato, and Chanel Mercedes Benz.

See you there!

Follow us on [url=https://www.instagram.com/playjackboxgames/][b]Instagram[/b][/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/jackboxgames][b]Twitter[/b][/url] to see pictures from the event, and don’t forget to tag us in yours!
